quickref.name: Steam Yard Blues (2026 spelling: "Steamyard Blues")
quickref.era: BBG v2.8: March 4, 2014 per the wiki [Fan-wiki]; SkyVu preview posted Feb 21, 2014 [Canon]. Launched with King of the Windmill, which was retired in v2.29 (Jan 26, 2018) [Fan-wiki]. Not in BBR. Wiki layout notes date from 2014.
quickref.in_2026: Probably returning. Steam jokes about "that yearly match on Steamyard Blues, most likely just for the soundtrack" [Canon]. Soundtrack track 15 is "Steamyard Blues" (0:51) [Canon]. SkyVu's "BBG Maps Ranked part 1" (Oct 11, 2026) shows its tile in the 16-map grid and puts it in the "13-16" tier [Observed]. Not in the 2026 trailer, the Steam screenshots or the news posts [Observed]. 2026 modes are TDM/FFA/PTB, so no King of the Windmill [Canon/Inference].
quickref.setting: A steam-age airship yard high in the air at dusk, open at the edges [Observed; the label is Inference]. Three wiki 'levels': the deck at the top (4 jump pads up; Bearscream Sandwich on a 'lead off'; a gear-like wall to hide behind), the main ground (planes, Imperial Basket Grande, slopes with Shields), and green tunnels reached from jump pads on the plane wings (Health Pack at the intersection) [Fan-wiki]. Spawns and team sides undocumented.
quickref.palette_and_lighting: Dusk: pale butter-yellow horizon glow #EEDC85-#F4D691 behind mauve-brown mountain silhouettes #492F38-#644B46, with a near-black maroon void below (#1C030E). Brass/gold #CE9430 (highlight #FEEA4F), copper #905122-#AD5C2D, purple airship fabric #240838-#390B53, slate-blue planes #304D5A-#325269, dark plank deck #21170B-#2F230B, cyan jump pads #5ADADB in acid-yellow gear housings #C6C209, green tunnels #688E45. Warm gold rim light, plum shadows; no steam or weather visible [Observed].
quickref.landmarks: 1) A purple blimp in a brass rib cage with stencilled propeller-and-monocle bear heads. 2) Twin slate-blue shark-mouth fighter planes with 'BBG' lettering and roundels, roped down, with a jump pad on each wing. 3) Cyan jump pads in brass gear housings, including gear-topped wicker drums with sandbags. 4) Green tunnels with octagonal mouths. 5) An upright purple-and-gold balloon on a copper crown-topped column. 6) The dusk mountain backdrop [Observed; layout from Fan-wiki].
quickref.hazards_and_easter_eggs: 'No interactive features' [Fan-wiki]. Jump pads; tunnel entrances reachable with the Turkish SW Boots; a ledge beneath one whole edge [Fan-wiki]. 2014-18 King of the Windmill: the windmill landed mid-map or on the deck's lead-off and could crush players [Fan-wiki]. Easter eggs: 'BBG' painted on the planes; RAF-style roundel and shark-mouth art; the bear emblem on the blimp [Observed]; hide behind the deck's gear wall [Fan-wiki]; SkyVu's 2026 'yearly match… just for the soundtrack' joke [Canon].
